exposure: Symptomatic urinary tract infection (UTI) in pregnancy
cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women attending the department of obstetrics and gynaecology over a one-year period.
finding: Symptomatic UTI was prevalent in 20% of the cases and was associated with various adverse maternal outcomes (e.g., abortions, anaemia, puerperal pyrexia, PIH) and fetal outcomes (e.g., preterm births, fetal growth restriction, perinatal mortality).
